strings.name: Patrick Collison
strings.role: Software entrepreneur · Stripe co-founder and CEO
strings.summary: Collison learned programming in Ireland, won a student award for Croma and helped build Auctomatic while also studying at MIT. In 2010 he and his brother John founded Stripe to simplify internet payments through software interfaces, later expanding merchant financial tools. He also worked on Fast Grants and Arc Institute, exploring more flexible support for science.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding Stripe advanced online payment interfaces and merchant finance tools, supporting digital entrepreneurship and cross-border business.
strings.facts.f1.label: Upbringing
strings.facts.f1.value: Grew up in Ireland, later moving to California.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Studied mathematics and physics at MIT without completing a degree there.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Payment infrastructure for business
strings.highlights.h1.text: With John and their team, he integrated payments, billing and other financial functions into programmable services.
strings.highlights.h2.title: New institutions for science
strings.highlights.h2.text: Fast research grants and Arc Institute seek sustained, flexible support for researchers.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Publishing the 2025 annual letter
strings.timeline.t1.text: With John, he reviewed Stripe and the internet economy; the reported $1.9 trillion was client transaction volume, not company revenue.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Stripe completes Bridge acquisition
strings.timeline.t2.text: Stablecoin infrastructure joined the company's financial products.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Launching Arc Institute
strings.timeline.t3.text: With Silvana Konermann and Patrick Hsu, he established an institution for long-term biomedical research.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Working on Fast Grants
strings.timeline.t4.text: With collaborators, he advanced rapid COVID-19 research funding to reduce application and approval delays.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Co-founding Stripe
strings.timeline.t5.text: He and John established a payments company for internet businesses and developers.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Auctomatic acquired
strings.timeline.t6.text: The trading-management software company built with his brother and other co-founders was sold to Live Current Media.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Building Auctomatic
strings.timeline.t7.text: With John and partners, he developed software for online sellers.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Irish Young Scientist award
strings.timeline.t8.text: He won for Croma, a language intended to simplify web application development.
